 Real Sociedad host Lyon at the Anoeta Stadium this Thursday, 5 November, in the fourth round of the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League league phase. Kick-off is scheduled for 17:45 UK time.
 The Spanish side will be looking to bounce back from their Basque derby defeat and build on an emphatic European victory over Lillestrom. Lyon, meanwhile, arrive after beating Angers but have struggled in recent away fixtures, including a 3-0 loss at Hoffenheim in their last Europa League outing.
 Our Real Sociedad vs Lyon prediction examines both teams’ recent form, European records, sports betting tips, and key players ahead of Thursday’s encounter.

 Real Sociedad vs. Lyon - Head-to-head record
 Real Sociedad have a perfect record against Lyon , having won both of their previous meetings in the 2013 Champions League play-off round.
 The Basque side won 2-0 in France before securing another 2-0 victory at home, progressing to the group stage with a 4-0 aggregate success. Lyon have yet to score against their Spanish opponents.
 Although those encounters took place more than a decade ago, they give Real Sociedad a positive historical record to draw on ahead of this meeting.

 Real Sociedad - Looking to bounce back
 Let’s take a closer look at Real Sociedad’s current situation ahead of this important European fixture. We will analyse the team’s recent form and results, highlighting their main strengths and weaknesses.
 Recent form
 Real Sociedad come into Thursday’s match after a 2-1 defeat to Athletic Bilbao in the Basque derby . That result ended a run of three consecutive wins, although they have still won three of their last four matches in all competitions.
 Their recent performances include a 2-1 victory over Levante and an impressive 6-0 away win against Lillestrom in the Europa League. They also beat Malaga 5-2, underlining their attacking potential.
 In Europe, Pellegrino Matarazzo’s side have collected four points from their first three matches. They lost 2-1 at home to Bournemouth, drew 1-1 away to Union SG and then thrashed Lillestrom 6-0. The defeat to Bournemouth remains their only loss in the competition so far.
 Luka Sučić has been particularly influential, scoring six goals in 13 appearances this season. Mikel Oyarzabal is another important attacking option and is expected to start.
 The hosts will not have a full squad available, with Luken Beitia, Álvaro Odriozola and Arsen Zakharyan all ruled out through injury.

 Lyon - Struggling on the road
 Now, let’s turn our attention to Lyon. We will examine their current form, recent results, and key players for the upcoming match in Spain.
 Recent form
 Lyon travel to San Sebastian after a 2-0 victory over Angers in Ligue 1, which ended a run of two consecutive defeats. Paulo Fonseca’s side had previously lost 2-1 to Lens and suffered a 3-0 defeat away to Hoffenheim in the Europa League.
 The French club has collected six points from their first three European matches, beating Anderlecht 2-1 and Crystal Palace 3-2 before losing in Germany. Their home performances have been encouraging , but the defeat to Hoffenheim highlighted their vulnerability away from home.
 Lyon will therefore need a significant improvement on the road if they are to take anything from Thursday’s match. Their recent European results also suggest that Real Sociedad could find opportunities against their defence.
 Noah Nartey has been one of Lyon’s standout performers this season, scoring twice from midfield. Keito Nakamura is another important attacking presence and is expected to feature in the starting line-up.
 However, the visitors have several injury concerns. Nicolas Tagliafico, Mohamed Ouedraogo, Tyler Morton, Pavel Šulc and Loïs Openda are all unavailable for the trip to Spain.

 Predictions for Real Sociedad vs. Lyon - Home victory on the cards
 Real Sociedad has been a force offensively, consistently finding the net in recent games. Given both teams’ high-scoring European matches, a decisive outcome seems probable, with over 2.5 goals scored.
 In contrast, Lyon struggles significantly on their travels, having lost their last three away fixtures. This poor form makes a “Real Sociedad Win or Draw” a solid consideration for this encounter in San Sebastian.
 Considering Real Sociedad’s historical advantage and Lyon’s difficulties on the road, the home side is favoured. Our main prediction is a victory for Real Sociedad to get their European campaign back on track at home.
